seo.title: Park City ski resort guide
seo.description: 7,300 acres and over 330 trails across two linked base villages, with seven terrain parks and a lift from Main Street.
seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, terrain by grade, where to stay and how to get to Park City in Utah.

h1: Park City ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Park City Mountain is 7,300 acres, the largest single figure in this batch, served by 41 lifts over more than 330 trails. Seven terrain parks is also the most of any resort here, and the Town Lift carries skiers straight out of the historic Main Street.
stayOverview: Main Street has the restaurants and its own lift; Canyons Village is the ski-in base on the other side of the same mountain. Both are on one pass.
hotelIntro: Book against high season, and pick between the old street and the purpose-built village - they are forty minutes apart on skis and twenty by bus.
rentalCars: Park City is about 35 miles from Salt Lake City airport, the shortest airport transfer of any major resort in this batch.
